title: Act: Add tokens module, Tailwind token plugin and theme values
description: Create tokens from PALETTE_RAMPS and expose them via a Tailwind plugin (:root vars) and theme.extend.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config theme.extend has sf colours, spacing, fontFamily
technical_constraints: One palette of at most 48 colours
definition_of_done: Tokens available as CSS variables and Tailwind values

steps.action: Import PALETTE_RAMPS from ./palette. Export COLOR_TOKENS as an object mapping ink, plum, moon, hoodie, wood, brass, parchment, lamp to PALETTE_RAMPS[ramp] arrays (no new hex literals). Export SPACING_TOKENS {1:'4px',2:'8px',3:'12px',4:'16px',6:'24px'}. Export TYPE_TOKENS {fontPixel:"'Press Start 2P', monospace", fontBody:"'VT323', monospace", sizeSm:'12px', sizeMd:'16px', sizeLg:'24px'}. Export tokensToCssVars(): Record<string,string> emitting --sf-color-<ramp>-<1..6>, --sf-space-<n>, --sf-font-pixel, --sf-font-body, --sf-size-<sm|md|lg>.
steps.code: export function tokensToCssVars(): Record<string,string> { /* build from the three maps */ }

steps.action: Import plugin from 'tailwindcss/plugin' and tokensToCssVars, SPACING_TOKENS, TYPE_TOKENS. Add theme.extend.colors.sf as an object mapping each COLOR_TOKENS key and step to var(--sf-color-<ramp>-<n>), theme.extend.spacing entries sf-<n> -> var(--sf-space-<n>), fontFamily pixel/body -> var(--sf-font-pixel)/var(--sf-font-body), fontSize sf-sm/md/lg -> var(--sf-size-*). Append plugin(({addBase}) => addBase({':root': tokensToCssVars(), body:{fontFamily:'var(--sf-font-body)'}})) to plugins after animate. Keep colors.pal, background, primary untouched.
steps.expected: npm run typecheck passes and config still exposes colors.pal
